description: Dark olive-grey wool tunic with warm gold-brown knotwork edging at neckline, cuffs and hem, cream linen underlayer visible below, broad decorated leather belt with medallions and long hanging strap, brown trousers and tall dark leather boots with wrapped straps. Layered dark green plaid woven cloak with knotwork border and fringed edge fastened at shoulder by a round brooch. Both hands visible, full tight curl cap and boots framed. No headgear, armor, weapon or text.
